title: Demo mutations from client.gleam helpers discard the updated store — create/edit vacancy and mark-opened are silent no-ops in demo mode
evidence:
let #(next, eff) =
        demo_api.create_vacancy(
          demo_store_of(model),
          payload,
          "",
          ApiReturnedVacancyCreate,
        )
      let _ = next
      eff
— DemoStore is a pure immutable record (demo_store.gleam:92 `pub type DemoStore { DemoStore(landlord:, vacancies:, notifications:) }`), and demo_store.create_vacancy returns the appended store: `#( DemoStore(..store, vacancies: list.append(store.vacancies, [DemoVacancy(...)])), vac )`. demo_update.gleam persists it correctly (`#(Model(..model, demo_store: Some(next)), eff)` at lines 226/386/392/522/547); the four client.gleam demo branches never write `demo_store: Some(next)` anywhere (grep confirms zero occurrences in client.gleam).
detail: The mutated store is dropped, so the model keeps the stale store: a created vacancy never appears on the dashboard (refetch reads stale store) and its handoff page get_detail errors; edit saves revert on refetch; opening a Submitted applicant (2 fixture apps are submitted) never flips to UnderReview. Breaks acceptance 'create/edit/archive vacancy work in demo state'. No demo_flow_test covers create/edit.
recommended_fix: In each of the four client.gleam demo branches, return the model with `demo_store: Some(next)` instead of discarding via `let _ = next` (mirror demo_update.gleam's pattern); add a demo_flow_test case for create/edit/open persistence.

title: VacancyEdit deep-link boots demo mode but no edit data is ever fetched — refresh on /vacancies/v-*/edit renders an empty edit form
evidence:
is_demo_route: `routes.VacancyDetail(id)
    | routes.VacancyEdit(id)
    | routes.VacancyHandoff(id) -> string.starts_with(id, "v-")` — but demo_entry_effects has no VacancyEdit arm (`_ -> []`), and enter_demo's request-id case only handles VacancyDetail/VacancyHandoff/ApplicationDetail. model.gleam:606-609: `vacancy_edit_loading: False, ... vacancy_edit_id: "",` are the boot values, and vacancy_edit.gleam:22 renders the form whenever `vacancy_edit_loading` is False.
detail: A full-page refresh or direct load of /vacancies/v-maples/edit matches is_demo_route → enter_demo, but nothing calls demo_api.get_for_edit and vacancy_edit_loading stays False, so the real edit form renders with empty initial fields and a back-link of "/vacancies/". In-SPA navigation to edit works; only the boot path is broken.
recommended_fix: Add a VacancyEdit arm to demo_entry_effects (demo_api.get_for_edit) and set vacancy_edit_loading/vacancy_edit_id in enter_demo for that route — or drop VacancyEdit from is_demo_route so the URL boots the normal (login-redirect) flow.

title: Diff introduces a duplicate-import compiler warning for gleam/uri
detail: The diff added `import gleam/uri.{type Uri}` alongside the existing `import gleam/uri as gleam_uri`, producing a new compiler warning. Build/tests still pass, but it's new warning noise against the project's clean-compile convention.
recommended_fix: Merge into a single import (`import gleam/uri.{type Uri} as gleam_uri`) or reference the type as `gleam_uri.Uri` and drop the added line.

title: Stale doc paragraph: handle_browser_change carries the visibilitychange-listener documentation
detail: The extraction moved the BrowserChangedUrl body into handle_browser_change but the doc comment of the following function (listen_visibility_refresh) got absorbed into handle_browser_change's doc string, misdocumenting both functions.
recommended_fix: Move the 'Register a visibilitychange listener...' paragraph back above listen_visibility_refresh (line 5798).

title: store-fallback helper duplicated: demo_store_of (client.gleam) and store_of (demo_update.gleam) are identical
detail: Same fallback logic in two private helpers. AGENTS.md's DRY rule (extract when logic repeats 2+ places) applies; if the fallback policy ever changes, the two copies can drift.
recommended_fix: Export one helper (e.g. `pub fn store_of` in demo/demo_store.gleam taking the Option(DemoStore)) and call it from both modules.
